items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Bechet played with us, he played at the Cotton Club too.

ctx.x: How long was Bechet in the band?

Bechet played with us, he played at the Cotton Club too. We enlarged the band. Toby, Bechet, Johnny Hodges, Carney, he stayed with us so then he wanted to go to Europe so he went to Europe and stayed.
But he got along well with everybody in the band?
